Inflation is measured every month as the year-on-year change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI). The CPI also provides an insight into how prices changed compared to the previous month. According to the flash estimate, consumer prices rose by 0.3 percent in August 2026 relative to July 2026.

# CPI report shows inflation eased in July to a 3.4% annual pace

Updated on: August 12, 2026 / 2:20 PM EDT
/ CBS News

Inflation eased for the second consecutive month, rising at a 3.4% annual pace in July, in line with economists' expectations and a signal that some consumer price pressures may be easing.

## By the numbers

Economists polled by the financial data firm FactSet predicted July inflation rose at an annual rate of 3.4%. The consumer price index, an inflation barometer, was up 3.4% from 12 months earlier, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said Wednesday.
